summary: Translate face gestures into legal discrete moves while separating camera orbit.
objective: Let me drag a cube face to preview a turn, then snap or cancel it and undo the committed move.
example_prompts: Let me drag a cube face to preview a turn, then snap or cancel it and undo the committed move.

entities.name: Cubies
entities.guidance: Use individual beveled bodies with separate sticker/face surfaces and narrow gaps; preserve sticker IDs on local faces.

entities.name: Turn preview
entities.guidance: Use a temporary layer pivot at the cube center with highlighted affected pieces.

entities.name: Gesture cue
entities.guidance: Show selected face normal and legal turn direction before commitment.

state_contract.model: Integer cubie positions and discrete orientation; gesture owns a temporary angle, legal move engine owns committed state.
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Pick face and drag beyond a declared dead zone.
Commit a quarter turn or cancel preview.
Undo and reset; allow orbit only outside active face gesture.

invariants: One gesture creates at most one move.
M followed by its inverse restores exact positions and orientations.
motion_guidance: Convert drag direction in the picked face frame, independent of camera orientation.
Commit exact discrete state once; reconstruct mesh transforms and remove temporary pivot.
known_limits: No physical friction, corner cutting or speedcubing hardware simulation.
Gesture arbitration and move correctness require runtime checks.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: WCA outer-face notation distinguishes clockwise quarter turns, counterclockwise quarter turns and half turns.
claims.scope: Outer-face move subset; source does not prescribe gesture controls.

object_craft.material: Slightly rough dark cubie bodies with separate satin colored face surfaces; bevel highlights reveal gaps without obscuring face identity.
object_craft.articulation: Temporary layer pivot previews a turn; exact cubie orientation is committed once by the move engine.
